docs.title: Hand + Body Lotion with Bergamot Water
docs.subtitle:
Our 99% natural citrus-scented hand and body lotion leaves skin feeling nourished, moisturised and lightly fragranced. T his uplifting lotion combines bergamot water with lemongrass oil to uplift and invigorate the senses whilst protecting and repairing the skin. 

Suitable for all skin types. For best results, use after cleansing with the UpCircle Hand + Body Wash with Kiwi Water. 

Inspiring, upcycling, uplifting: Our hand + body lotion is infused with the residual water of organic bergamot fruit, a by-product of the juicing industry. 

The UpCircle Promise 
100 per cent vegan, cruelty-free and UK-made. Housed in a glass bottle with plastic pump. For a plastic-free repeat order, simply save the pump from your first bottle and select "Repeat order - aluminium cap" from the drop-down menu when you make a repeat purchase!
docs.pivota_insight_summary: Hand + Body Lotion with Bergamot Water is a body care treatment from UpCircle Beauty, with source-backed cues around cleansing and hydration.

docs.title: RETURN + REFILL Organic Face Oil with Coffee Extract - ON PAUSE
docs.subtitle:
Our Refill Scheme is on hold! We're working on a new solution for 2026. Watch this space! 

Return, Refill, Reuse

With our refill scheme you need to have empty UpCircle packaging to return to us. Once you’ve placed your order, you’ll be emailed all the information you need to return your empty packaging to us including the Freepost label.

Existing customers only - please ensure you already have your face oil bottle to be returned! 

Thoroughly wash and dry your Serum bottle using warm soapy water 

Remove your dropper and keep somewhere safe- we don't need this returned. Please also remove the plastic ring seal around the top of the serum bottle.

Pack your empties up ready to be posted - we recommend saving your original packaging. I f you haven't got your original packaging please wrap them carefully. 

After checking out you will receive an email with a free post label

Print and attach this label to the parcel and drop to your local Post Office - if you don't have a printer, you can handwrite the address on instead 

Once we have received your empties back we will sterilise the jars using dry heat and refill your jar with a fresh batch of face serum

We aim to turn around refills within 24 hours of receiving them

Your refilled bottle will be returned to you to enjoy! 

*Please note, if you are ordering new products as well as refills these will be sent when your refills are returned to you.
docs.pivota_insight_summary: RETURN + REFILL Organic Face Oil with Coffee Extract - ON PAUSE is a treatment serum from UpCircle Beauty.

docs.title: Cinnamon + Ginger Chai Cleansing Bar
docs.subtitle:
An award-winning gently exfoliating cleansing bar to purify and energise. Pink clay reduces redness and irritation, whilst organic cinnamon and ginger oils give skin a reviving energy boost. Glycerin hydrates and moisturises the skin.

Perfect for use on both face and body.

Inspiring, upcycling, uplifting: This cinnamon + ginger cleansing soap is made with residual chai spices used to create chai syrups.

Winner in the Beauty Shortlist Awards 2021.

The UpCircle Promise 
Certified Organic with Soil Association, 100% natural, vegan, palm oil-free, sustainable and cruelty-free. Made in UK.
docs.pivota_insight_summary: Cinnamon + Ginger Chai Cleansing Bar is a face cleanser from UpCircle Beauty, with source-backed cues around cleansing and dirt, oil, and impurity removal.

docs.title: Cleansing Face Milk with Oat Powder + Aloe Vera
docs.subtitle:
When applied to the face, this creamy oat powder repairs and restores the skin’s moisture barrier. This multi-award winning oat cleanser has a milky, creamy formula that hydrates and nourishes the skin. You can think of the oat powder as the oat milk to your latte and the other ingredients as the skin-loving syrup shots. Suitable for all skin types, this everyday vegan facial cleanser leaves skin buttery soft.

Inspiring, upcycling, uplifting: Our gentle cleansing face milk is made with oat powder upcycled from the food and drink industry. Dermatologically approved for use on sensitive skin. Suitable for use on babies and children.
docs.pivota_insight_summary: Cleansing Face Milk with Oat Powder + Aloe Vera is a face color product from UpCircle Beauty, with source-backed cues around a cream-powder texture.
